projectBaseline.description: Product scope: PMBus numeric-format calculator (LINEAR11 / VOUT-LINEAR16 / DIRECT / IEEE 754 binary16 bidirectional conversion). Validated reference: PMBus 1.3/1.3.1 public archive and SMBus 3.0. Current published revision: PMBus 1.5 (official site), noted for awareness only. Full PMBus 1.5 compliance is not claimed; bus transport, command execution, device profiles, PMBus 1.5 security extensions and Part IV are out of scope. This manifest is the machine-readable provenance source for third-party specification PDFs; the PDFs themselves are not tracked in the Git tree and must be fetched on demand from the official URLs below.
